=== General ===
[Updates]
  Map Rotation:
  • Ranked
    • [Undocumented] Blackheart's Bay removed.
    • [Undocumented] Hanamura Temple added.
    • [Undocumented] Volskaya Foundry added.
    • [Undocumented] Warhead Junction removed.
  Structures:
  • Towers, Forts, Keeps, and Core
    • Structures now prioritize Summons when there are no remaining Minions.
    • Summons no longer take half damage from Structures.
  • Watch Towers
    • Watch Towers will now reset to neutral after 45 seconds of not being occupied.
  Experience:
  • Experience Globe pickup sound is now also played when killing a Minion that instantly yields Experience.
  User Interface:
  • Pinnacle Rewards have been renamed to Mythic Rewards .

=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Globe of Annihilation [Q]
    • Additional functionality: Now deals 50% damage to non-Heroes [Undocumented] (excluding Summons) .
    • Reward: Upon reaching 225 Annihilation, Globe of Annihilation no longer deals reduced damage to ~~non-Heroes~~ Minions and Mercenaries.

    • [Undocumented] Additional functionality: Deals 100% more damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

    • [Undocumented] Demon Lieutenant duration effectively increased from 20 to 21 seconds.
